presets.name: Devices
presets.description: All managed devices with the most used columns (Devices > All devices > Export).

presets.name: DeviceCompliance
presets.description: Compliance state per device (Reports > Device compliance).

presets.name: DeviceComplianceTrend
presets.description: Daily device counts per compliance state, OS family and ownership (compliance trend).

presets.name: DevicesWithoutCompliancePolicy
presets.description: Devices that have no compliance policy assigned.

presets.name: AppInstallStatus
presets.description: Install status per app, aggregated (Apps > Monitor > App install status).

presets.name: AppInstallStatusByDevice
presets.description: Install status of one app per device and user, with error codes. Needs -ApplicationId.

presets.name: RemediationResults
presets.description: Detection and remediation output of one Remediation per device. Needs -PolicyId (the Remediation ID).

presets.name: FeatureUpdateDeviceState
presets.description: Feature update state per device for one feature update policy. Needs -PolicyId.
